name: Alert
description: Highlights information, warnings or errors inline, with context and a clear next action.

children.description: Alert content - use Alert.Icon, Alert.Body, Alert.Title, Alert.Content, Alert.Actions, Alert.Close sub-components

tone.description: Tone; sets the tint fill, the icon, the title ink and the live-region role

open.description: Controlled visibility. Leave unset and the alert hides itself once Alert.Close is pressed.

onOpenChange.description: Called with false when Alert.Close is pressed

when: Flagging a risk before the user hits it
A failure the user must fix, said where it happened
Standing information that must stay on screen
whenNot: A one-word status or a pass verdict (use Badge)
A confirmation that should fade away (use Toast)
An invalid field (use the Input error prop)
A decision the user must make first (use Dialog)
A neutral note with no state (use Text or Box)
guidelines: Match tone to real stakes; an error that is not an error trains people to ignore you
There is no success tone: a pass goes to a Badge verdict and a confirmation to Toast
Every danger alert says what to do next
Add Alert.Title only when the message needs two lines
At most two actions; Alert.Action is a small soft Button and they wrap under the copy
Only dismissible when losing the message costs nothing; use open and onOpenChange to bring it back
Alert.Action and Alert.Close default to type="button", so they are safe inside a form
Alert.Close runs your onClick and still respects preventDefault()
accessibility: role="alert" (warning, danger) means assistive tech announces it on arrival; info uses role="status"
aria-labelledby and aria-describedby point only at a Title and Content that render
Alert.Close is labelled "Dismiss alert" unless you pass your own aria-label
Icon plus wording carry the tone, never colour alone

examples.name: Info
examples.description: Neutral context — nothing went wrong, nothing needs doing.
examples.code:
import { Alert } from '@/components/Alert';

<Alert tone="info">
  <Alert.Icon />
  <Alert.Body>
    <Alert.Content>
      Your session will expire in 15 minutes. Save your work to avoid losing changes.
    </Alert.Content>
  </Alert.Body>
</Alert>

examples.name: Warning
examples.description: Nothing is broken yet — act before it is.
examples.code:
import { Alert } from '@/components/Alert';

<Alert tone="warning">
  <Alert.Icon />
  <Alert.Body>
    <Alert.Title>Storage almost full</Alert.Title>
    <Alert.Content>
      You have used 90% of your storage quota. Consider deleting unused files.
    </Alert.Content>
  </Alert.Body>
</Alert>

examples.name: Error
examples.description: Something failed; say what to do about it.
examples.code:
import { Alert } from '@/components/Alert';

<Alert tone="danger">
  <Alert.Icon />
  <Alert.Body>
    <Alert.Title>Upload failed</Alert.Title>
    <Alert.Content>
      The file could not be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.
    </Alert.Content>
  </Alert.Body>
</Alert>

examples.name: With Action
examples.description: One small soft button; a second verb wraps beside it, never more.
examples.code:
import { Alert } from '@/components/Alert';

<Alert tone="warning">
  <Alert.Icon />
  <Alert.Body>
    <Alert.Title>Update available</Alert.Title>
    <Alert.Content>
      A new version is available with important security fixes.
    </Alert.Content>
    <Alert.Actions>
      <Alert.Action onClick={() => {}}>Update now</Alert.Action>
    </Alert.Actions>
  </Alert.Body>
</Alert>

examples.name: Dismissible
examples.description: A close button suits news the user can safely ignore.
examples.code:
import { Alert } from '@/components/Alert';

<Alert tone="info">
  <Alert.Icon />
  <Alert.Body>
    <Alert.Content>
      You can customize your notification preferences in Settings.
    </Alert.Content>
  </Alert.Body>
  <Alert.Close />
</Alert>

examples.name: Controlled
examples.description: open and onOpenChange let the page bring a dismissed alert back.
examples.code:
import { Alert } from '@/components/Alert';

const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(true);

<Alert tone="info" open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  <Alert.Icon />
  <Alert.Body>
    <Alert.Content>The scan finished with no new findings.</Alert.Content>
  </Alert.Body>
  <Alert.Close />
</Alert>

relations.note: Use Badge for compact, inline status labels
Use Toast for transient notifications that auto-dismiss

propsSummary: tone: info|warning|danger - tint, icon, title ink and live-region role
Sub-components: Alert.Icon, Alert.Body, Alert.Title, Alert.Content, Alert.Actions, Alert.Action, Alert.Close
Alert.Action is a soft small Button; Alert.Close is a ghost xs IconButton; both default type="button"
